what_it_does: MOKA improves the first-level data cache (L1D cache) by smarter prefetching—predicting when to fetch data before the processor needs it. The key insight: prefetchers sometimes request data from across page boundaries (memory segments), and this can either help or hurt performance depending on the workload and current system state. MOKA uses machine learning models to decide whether cross-page prefetching should be enabled, accounting for translation lookaside buffer (TLB) pressure and memory subsystem occupancy.
